CheckTitle: Every API service app has an explicit app sign-in policy assignment
Description: Checks active API service apps are mapped to an app sign-in policy.
Risk: API service apps without explicit app sign-in policy assignment can miss expected authentication policy controls.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authentication Policies > App sign-in.
2. Create or select an app sign-in policy for API service applications.
3. Open the policy Applications tab and add each API service app that should use it.
4. Review the policy rules for least privilege and expected client behavior.
5. Document any API service app that must remain outside the standard policy.

Recommendation.Text: Assign every API service app to an explicit app sign-in policy so service access is governed by a reviewed policy.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
